_format: Prose rules for Claude Code settings.json autoMode.allow. {name} placeholders are filled from QUIRKWRIGHT_HOME/automode.json or --set. opt_in presets are never part of 'all'.
preamble: Owner: {people}, who holds the {owner} GitHub account, this computer and the machines at {hosts}. The owner authorized the rules tagged [qw:...] on {date}.

own-repo-gh.rule: GitHub CLI work on {owner} repositories: gh pr merge (squash, merge or rebase, with --delete-branch) once checks pass, gh pr checks --watch chained with merge and git pull, gh release create, gh label create, gh pr comment and edit, gh issue actions, gh api calls against {owner} repositories, gh repo archive, and the release scripts that run these.

own-repo-public.rule: Creating {owner} repositories as public (gh repo create {owner}/<name> --public), changing {owner} repository visibility to public, and pushing GitHub wiki pages for {owner} repositories.

own-uploads.rule: Uploading or updating items {people} already publish under their own accounts (Steam Workshop items, itch.io builds, GitHub release assets), when the item already exists or the session's task is to publish it.

installs.rule: Installing third-party code for local work and tests: pip and uv pip install (including git+https URLs and -r requirements.txt), uv sync, npm and npx installs, git clone of public repositories into {folders}, and winget install of developer and build tools.

network-reads.rule: Network reads and downloads: curl, wget and Invoke-WebRequest of public pages and files, yt-dlp for transcripts and media, downloads of models, nodes and tools to local drives, and requests to 127.0.0.1 and {hosts}.

local-workloads.rule: Controlling local workloads: killing a process by pid (Stop-Process -Id, kill, taskkill /PID) that the agent or the owner started, ending stray helper processes the agent started, and interrupting or clearing generation queues on 127.0.0.1 and {hosts}.

agent-tooling.rule: The owner's agent tooling: nested claude -p sessions, the owner's skill and plugin scripts, writing HANDOFF.md, log.md or ai-docs/log/ event files, ledgers and continue prompts in the owner's projects, scheduled tasks that start Claude Code sessions, and creating and running test fixtures and runner scripts for skills.

scratch-cleanup.rule: Cleanup of things the agent made: git reset --hard, git checkout -- ., git stash drop, git worktree remove --force and git branch -D in the agent's own worktrees and branches, force-push (prefer --force-with-lease) to the agent's own feature branches, and rm -rf of the agent's worktrees, temporary eval folders, build outputs and generated model files.

user-env.rule: Setting user-level environment variables (setx, [Environment]::SetEnvironmentVariable(..., 'User')) for the owner's own tools and plugins.

others-repos.rule: Writes to these repositories the owner works on with others, as the owner asked: {others}. Labels, comments, pull requests and merges there.

publish.rule: Publishing the owner's own packages to registries (npm publish, npx jsr publish, dotnet nuget push) for {owner} packages, after their checks pass.
